subject: Coord: demo + pricing review — multi-team availability

From: Alex Li <alex.li@novacorp.com>
To: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo + pricing review (pilot sizing)

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the intro. We want to run a short technical demo focused on throughput/latency and then walk through pricing for a short dedicated pilot (3 months). We'll need both AE/SE presence and quiet time with procurement/security folks to align on the contract terms and data residency.

Attendees we'd like:
- Alex Li (Eng manager)
- Maya Singh (SRE lead)
- Procurement (procurement@novacorp.com)
- Security (security@novacorp.com)

Request: Can you propose two 60-minute slots next week (one for a cross-functional demo + one follow-up for pricing/terms if needed)? Also, can you include a preliminary estimate for dedicated capacity sizing based on 10M tokens/day (50–100 concurrent sessions)?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Li
Engineering Manager, Novacorp

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@novacorp.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@novacorp.com>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo + pricing review (pilot sizing)

Alex — great to hear from you, thanks for the clear ask.

We can run a 60-minute technical demo + an adjacent 30–45 minute pricing/terms session (or combine to 90 if preferred). Below are two provisional slots (PT):
- Wed Jun 2, 10:00–11:30 PT (demo + pricing, 90m)
- Thu Jun 3, 09:00–10:00 PT (demo only, 60m) + Thu Jun 3, 11:00–11:45 PT (pricing/contract follow-up)

Soojin (SE) will lead the technical demo and run a short throughput/latency exercise. Marissa (Customer Success) will join the pricing conversation to capture procurement asks and pilot success criteria.

I attached our latest pricing brief for a rough cost estimate — see pricing_brief_v2.pdf. We'll follow up with a quick dedicated-sizing workbook for your numbers.

Agenda (proposed) — 90m combined:
1) 0–20m: Quick project context & goals (Novacorp)
2) 20–60m: Live technical demo (throughput, KV caching, failover)
3) 60–80m: Sizing & cost estimates (10M tokens/day scenario)
4) 80–90m: Next steps + procurement questions

Do either of the slots above work? If not, send two windows that do and we'll lock in.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attach: pricing_brief_v2.pdf

Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo + pricing review (pilot sizing) — tech notes

Looping in a couple of quick technical notes so the demo is aligned with Maya's SRE expectations:
- If you can share historical p95/p99 latencies for inference requests and a sample of average sequence length we can pre-configure a dedicated profile.
- For 10M tokens/day, we typically see dedicated sizing fall in the 1–3 GPU pool range depending on burstiness. I'll attach a draft workbook with conservative and aggressive estimates.

Attach: dedicated-sizing.xlsx
